name: attention-controller-disturbance-v1
training_checkpoint: All-source outcomes train under matched metadata. Only source-0 is eligible during warmup, producing equal counts and prior focus/wait states across arms; checkpoint equality is checked. Settings never change across warmup/evaluation.
eligibility: Independent fixture resets processed markers each tick to model repeated sampling opportunities. Warmup leases exclude sources 1-4. Evaluation lease exclusion at offset 3, empty eligibility at offset 5. Product eligibility is not bypassed by attention.
disturbance: source-0 stable; other source facts change on (tick+seed+source_index)%3 != 0. Held-out source-4 loss at offsets 2 and 3, restoration at 4. At offset 6, source-0 changes after selection immediately before the real Controller refresh: a filesystem disturbance at the declared observation boundary independent of selection and arm. New source-5 configuration arrival at 10 causes explicit scope mismatch. Restart at 7, horizon expiration at 8 (clock advances ttl+1). Disturbances do not depend on selected IDs or arm.
planner: Deterministic empty candidate list, real Controller _synthesize and real planner_method receipts. Accepted goals are accounted as zero by design; this exposure/freshness experiment does not measure business task benefit. Runs stub rejects every provider boundary.
fairness: Fixed N continuously eligible, K fixed capacity, W threshold: selection gap <= W+ceil(N/K)-1 observation ticks. Churn, eligibility interruption and horizon time are outside this bound.
interpretation: Deterministic provider-free software falsification protocol. No promised benefit, subjective awareness, hidden activations, complete AST or GWT. Evaluation section is temporally held out but the declared model keeps learning. Full five-sequence panel is run after final product stability; unit tests run only one-sequence smoke.
